questions: score:specificity - vague drift (1) to a named business consequence in their own words (5); choice:answer_type - named_consequence, tactic_fixation, generic_growth, cannot_answer
action: Code records the answer type on the ICP scorecard and flags cannot_answer or vague as a critical Anti-ICP signal for the owner
why_jev: Clark calls this the highest-fidelity Anti-ICP signal; scoring the answer live on a transcript chunk surfaces it before the call ends.
doctrine: A prospect who cannot name the business problem is the strongest Anti-ICP signal.

title: Detect Anti-ICP conversational tells in a call transcript
item: A segment of a discovery call transcript
questions: noul:revolving_door_of_agencies_blames_all; noul:expects_low_price; noul:single_tactic_fixation; noul:never_hired_agency; noul:resists_diagnosis
action: Code tallies tells and drafts the scorecard flags for the owner to confirm
why_jev: Five atomic tells are exactly the shape of a noul bank; the owner reviews a pre-filled scorecard rather than rebuilding it from memory within 24 hours.
doctrine: Anti-ICP tells: revolving-door agencies, low-price expectation, single-tactic fixation, no agency history, advice resistance.

title: Classify prospect reaction to a stated price range
item: The prospect's response after Clark states a price range
questions: choice:reaction - accepts_range, asks_about_value, anchors_lower, shocked_too_high, wants_scope_cut, no_clear_reaction
action: Code writes the reaction on the scorecard and warns against discounting without a scope reduction when anchors_lower or shocked_too_high
why_jev: The reaction type decides between a value conversation and a decline; a closed label on the reply text prepares the owner's next move.
doctrine: Do not reflexively discount; hold the floor and discount only against a clear scope reduction.

title: Check discovery call questions follow the SPIN sequence
item: One question asked by the AM or owner in the call
questions: choice:spin_type - situation, problem, implication, need_payoff, other; noul:leading_or_closed
action: Code reports the mix (situation capped at 3, implications present) for coaching
why_jev: A SPIN mix report across recorded calls teaches new AMs without a manager listening to hours of recordings.
doctrine: Follow SPIN: few situation questions, then problem, implication, and need-payoff questions.

title: Verify a call ends with a named Advance
item: The final minutes of a discovery call transcript
questions: noul:specific_dated_next_step_agreed; choice:close_type - advance, continuation_vague, no_next_step
action: Code reminds the owner within an hour when the close type is not advance and schedules the follow-up
why_jev: A vague 'I'll send you something' correlates with deal loss; a quick check of the call end prompts a calendar action at once.
doctrine: Never end a call without a named Advance; vague continuations correlate with lost deals.

title: Place a prospect's problem into the Marketing Model
item: The prospect's problem statement from the call
questions: choice:upstream_section - being_feeling, searching, site_visiting, converting_sharing; choice:also_broken - multi-select of other sections
action: Code writes the upstream-most section as the lead diagnosis on the needs assessment and lists others as downstream symptoms
why_jev: Naming the section reframes tactics into a system; a typed placement gives the needs assessment its first line consistently.
doctrine: Lead with the upstream-most failure and treat the other broken sections as downstream symptoms.

title: Block disclosure of prior legal clients in proposals
item: A proposal or call-prep sentence referencing past work
questions: noul:names_or_identifies_prior_legal_client; noul:reveals_case_type_or_outcome
action: Code blocks the sentence and substitutes a generic phrase such as 'a law firm we work with'
why_jev: Rule 1.6 exposure comes through vendor disclosure; a quick guard in the proposal pipeline protects clients and agency.
doctrine: Do not reference prior legal clients by name, practice area, case type, or matter without written consent.

title: Triage an inbound inquiry for basic fit
item: An inbound form submission or email from a prospect
questions: choice:vertical_fit - tier1_medical_aesthetic, tier1_legal_estate, other_vertical; noul:owner_operated; noul:geography_in_scope; noul:stated_single_tactic_only
action: Code routes qualified inquiries to the owner calendar and sends the rest to the decline-and-refer template queue
why_jev: Sales-lead triage is fast, repeated, and rule-shaped; facts such as geography are code, while vertical and tactic-only intent are semantic labels.
doctrine: Basic-fit on geography, vertical, and ownership is checked before an inquiry reaches the owner's calendar.

title: Judge a needs assessment for completeness
item: A written needs assessment
questions: noul:has_verbatim_problem_quote; noul:states_binding_constraint; noul:states_success_state; noul:states_price_range_and_rationale
action: Code blocks proposal drafting until all four are present
why_jev: The needs assessment seeds the proposal and is skipped when rushed; four structural yes/no checks keep the bridge intact.
doctrine: Write the needs assessment within 24 hours; call notes alone routinely fail to produce a coherent proposal.

title: Select which prior decisions constrain a client call
item: A call topic and one entry from the client's decision log
questions: noul:constrains_this_topic; choice:status - settled, revisit_expected, outdated
action: Code puts settled, relevant decisions in the prep brief's constraints section and drops irrelevant ones
why_jev: Context selection: only relevant prior decisions belong in the brief; a per-entry relevance call is cheaper than feeding the whole log to an LLM.
doctrine: A settled positioning, scope, or constraint should shape the recommendation unless the call is about revisiting it.

title: Separate facts from interpretations in a call brief
item: One sentence in a prep brief
questions: choice:kind - traceable_fact, interpretation, recommendation, missing_context_flag; noul:has_source
action: Code flags facts without a source and interpretations stated as fact, and returns the brief for repair
why_jev: The brief standard requires traceable facts; typing each sentence lets code enforce source requirements consistently.
doctrine: Keep source facts traceable; recommendations must explain the step from fact to action.

title: Classify a client request against SOW services
item: An inbound request from a client
questions: choice:service - one entry per SOW service, plus new_project_quote, plus not_agency_scope; noul:in_current_retainer
action: Code routes in-scope requests to the right team queue and flags new project quotes to the AM for scope conversation
why_jev: Scope creep starts at intake; a catalog lookup of 'which service is this' at arrival is fast and consistent.
doctrine: Surface unclear ownership and scope early in the prep brief rather than after the work is done.

title: Check report narrative for vanity framing
item: A sentence from a monthly client report
questions: choice:framing - mechanism_explained, vanity_number_only, operations_issue_called_out, jargon_heavy; noul:ties_to_model_section
action: Code returns vanity_only and jargon-heavy sentences to the AM for rewriting before the report goes out
why_jev: The report guide asks for the mechanism behind a metric; a typed label on every sentence enforces it without the strategist re-reading every report.
doctrine: Report the why behind a metric, such as an operations cause for a conversion trend, not vanity numbers.

title: Flag savings language on budget-constrained accounts
item: A draft report line about ad spend or results
questions: noul:claims_savings_from_cutting_waste; noul:account_is_budget_limited_context
action: Code (reading the impression-share fact) blocks savings framing and substitutes 'more conversions at the same spend'
why_jev: Freed spend is reallocated on constrained accounts, so a savings claim is misleading; code knows the constraint, Jev spots the claim.
doctrine: Do not report reallocation as savings; success is more conversions at the same spend.

title: Look up a campaign's standing exemption purpose
item: A campaign's name, type, and budget
questions: choice:purpose - lead_gen, brand_protection, gbp_ctr_support, remarketing, experiment_arm, unknown
action: Code subtracts exempt purposes from zero-conversion sorts before the audit list is built
why_jev: Exempt campaigns surface at the top of every sort; labelling purpose once per campaign keeps the sort clean in every future cycle.
doctrine: Subtract known exemptions before sorting the zero-conversion list.

title: Detect negatives still present on the landing page
item: A negative keyword and a landing-page text or alt text snippet
questions: noul:page_contains_negated_meaning
action: Code lists pages whose text still contains negatived terms and opens a page-edit task
why_jev: Mixed signals confuse the algorithm; checking that a negative's meaning is absent from the page needs fuzzy matching beyond exact strings.
doctrine: If you negative a term, remove it from the landing page, including alt text, metadata, and hidden divs.

title: Flag bundled changes in a change log entry
item: A proposed account mutation description
questions: noul:bundles_multiple_concerns; choice:concern - budget, bidding, keywords, negatives, ads, targeting, tracking
action: Code splits or rejects bundled mutations to keep one concern per write for clean logs and rollback
why_jev: One concern per mutation keeps the ledger legible; a guard on every change description enforces it.
doctrine: One concern per mutation so the log and any rollback stay legible.

title: Classify a Google-suggested GBP edit as correct or wrong
item: A Google-suggested edit to NAP, hours, or category with the canonical NAP
questions: noul:matches_canonical_data; noul:introduces_new_error
action: Code auto-accepts matches and queues errors for rejection, logging every change
why_jev: Google applies community edits that drift NAP; monthly spot-checks become a continuous guard with a cheap compare against canonical data.
doctrine: Check for auto-edits Google applies from Maps contributions and reject incorrect suggestions.

title: Flag unearned causal claims about disavow results
item: A report sentence about ranking changes after a disavow
questions: noul:claims_disavow_caused_improvement; noul:evidence_is_timing_only
action: Code blocks causal language before the 2-week, 4-week, and 3-month check-in reports are sent
why_jev: The monitoring SOP warns against calling correlation causation; a guard on report text enforces careful claims.
doctrine: Do not claim rank improvements as proof of a disavow; calling correlation causation misleads clients.

title: Spot over-pruned entries in a past disavow file
item: A domain entry from an inherited disavow with its profile
questions: choice:entry_type - spam_or_pbn, real_world_business, legitimate_directory, unclear; noul:page_level_entry_without_reason
action: Code lists real_world_business and legitimate_directory entries as removal candidates to flag to the PM
why_jev: Old disavows silently block pagerank; labelling each inherited entry shows what to remove before building a new file.
doctrine: Past disavows are often over-pruned; review and consider removing entries.

title: Check title tags for local format and value proposition
item: A service page title tag and meta description
questions: noul:uses_keyword_plus_location_pattern; noul:meta_states_clear_value_proposition
action: Code queues failures for rewrite alongside the pixel-width truncation check done in code
why_jev: Format and length are code; whether the meta states a value proposition is semantic and has to be checked on every page.
doctrine: Titles follow primary keyword plus brand or city and specialty; meta carries keyword and clear value.

title: Check GBP description and service names for stuffing
item: A GBP description or service name string
questions: noul:keyword_stuffed; noul:natural_language
action: Code returns stuffed entries for rewrite before submission and keeps within the 750 character limit
why_jev: Stuffing is a style judgment that varies; a quick natural-language check protects every profile edit.
doctrine: No keyword stuffing in the business description; services use keyword-rich but natural names.

title: Rotate GBP post types across the month
item: A drafted GBP post
questions: choice:post_type - announcement, seasonal_offer, local_event, blog_link, educational, other
action: Code builds the monthly rotation and flags runs of the same type for replacement
why_jev: Post-type rotation is a content-calendar rule; labelling drafts lets code enforce variety and cadence.
doctrine: Rotate post types: announcements, seasonal offers, local events, and blog shares.

title: Classify drift type in a quarterly NAP scan
item: One flagged listing diff from a citation scan
questions: choice:drift - formatting_variant, wrong_phone, old_address, name_variant, new_duplicate, auto_edited_by_directory
action: Code files corrections by drift type and sends new_duplicate to senior-seo before action
why_jev: A scan diff is a pile of wordy mismatches; a closed drift label routes each to the right fix and avoids destructive duplicate actions.
doctrine: Correct drift directly rather than waiting for the annual refresh; flag new duplicates before acting.

title: Place a new note in the correct brain folder
item: A draft note's title, first paragraph, and source type
questions: choice:folder - sources, entities, concepts, foundation, operating_doctrine, verticals, sops, patterns, templates, ventures, policies, contracts, domains, onboarding, postmortems, comparisons, agency, inbox_hold
action: Code writes the proposed path and frontmatter type, and sends inbox_hold or low-confidence items to a human before ingest
why_jev: The index defines a first-match-wins decision tree of 18 destinations; a closed menu with an inbox escape is the textbook catalog lookup, and ingest volume makes hand placement a bottleneck.
doctrine: Top-down tree, first match wins: outside source, person, concept, identity, framework, vertical, SOP; otherwise inbox.

title: Route a question to the right SOP or skill
item: A staffer's or agent's task statement and the SOP index with one-line descriptions
questions: choice:sop - one entry per SOP, plus no_existing_sop; noul:needs_client_state_first
action: Code opens the matching SOP and its prerequisites, or creates a gap issue when no_existing_sop
why_jev: 'Do not invent a procedure that already exists' is step 3 of the router; a 57-way lookup with an escape is trivial for Jev and costs far less than an LLM search.
doctrine: Check how agency already does it: SOPs and skills exist, so do not invent a procedure.

title: Verify an agent answer locates the problem first
item: An agent's draft answer to a marketing question
questions: noul:states_model_location_first; noul:names_candidate_sections_when_ambiguous; noul:grounded_in_client_state_before_edits
action: Code rejects drafts failing any check and asks the agent to repair before the user sees the answer
why_jev: The router's two rules (locate first, ground before you act) are structural properties of the answer; yes/no verification is cheap and keeps agents on the path.
doctrine: State the location first and ground in client state before proposing tactics.

title: Check that a recommendation relies on approved sources
item: A recommendation and its cited note metadata
questions: noul:rests_only_on_unapproved_or_evidence_only_source; choice:authority_basis - approved_doctrine, approved_sop, interpretive_concept, evidence_only_source
action: Code labels recommendations by authority basis and warns when only evidence-only material supports an action
why_jev: Notes carry advice_status fields; a classifier plus code surfaces actions that rest on unpromoted material.
doctrine: Dated source guidance remains distinct from approved agency procedures; do not act on evidence-only notes.

title: Detect a new source contradicting existing doctrine
item: A claim from a new source and a candidate existing doctrine claim
questions: choice:relation - supports, extends, contradicts, unrelated; noul:supersedes_existing_note
action: Code opens a destruction-half review item (supersede, prune, retire) for contradicts and supersedes cases
why_jev: The brain needs a prune and supersede half, not only accumulation; pairwise relation labels let code find candidate conflicts that no one is reading for.
doctrine: A brain needs a destruction half: prune, supersede, and retire as well as accumulate.

title: Rank client-call context layers by relevance
item: A call topic and a list of candidate notes or client files
questions: score:relevance - irrelevant (1) to essential (5)
action: Code assembles the prep bundle from items scoring 4-5 within the token budget
why_jev: Context selection before an expensive LLM write: a cheap relevance score per chunk shrinks a large file set to the few that belong in the brief.
doctrine: The right context layers should be available so the human is better prepared.

title: Classify marketing questions to Marketing Model layer for retrieval
item: A user's marketing question
questions: choice:layer - why_doctrine, how_sop_or_skill, brand_standard, client_state, business_model_outside; noul:client_deliverable
action: Code calls the right gateway tool first and enforces 'read brand standard first' for client deliverables
why_jev: The gateway tells agents to classify by layer before looking; a cheap classifier makes that routing automatic and consistent.
doctrine: Classify the question by layer: why, how, brand standard, client state; check the agency's layers before web search.

title: Classify discovery-call pre-research findings for Anti-ICP signals
item: A sentence from a prospect's public reviews or social presence
questions: choice:signal - civility_problem_owner_side, positive_depth, thin_evidence, complaint_pattern, neutral; noul:anti_icp_risk
action: Code pre-fills the ICP hypothesis and sets a cancel-or-keep recommendation for the owner
why_jev: Pre-call research reads the latest 20 reviews; labelling each review sentence makes the review scan quick and consistent across dozens of inquiries.
doctrine: Scan the latest 20 and oldest 5 reviews for tone, volume, recency, and response pattern.

title: Detect missing handoff of needs assessment to proposal owner
item: A proposal draft and the needs assessment
questions: noul:proposal_addresses_stated_binding_constraint; noul:uses_prospect_language
action: Code flags proposals disconnected from the needs assessment for review before sending
why_jev: Handoff failure is a named mistake; a coherence check between two documents catches drift cheaply before a proposal goes out.
doctrine: The needs assessment is the bridge between discovery and SOW; make sure the proposal uses it.

title: Check proposal tier options for pricing coherence
item: Three proposal options (scope, deliverables, price)
questions: choice:option_type - good, better, best; noul:scopes_are_nested_and_distinct; noul:price_ladder_coherent
action: Code asks the author to repair non-nested or incoherent tiers before sending
why_jev: Three-options proposals need distinct nested tiers; a coherence check on the text is a cheap guard.
doctrine: Hold the pricing floor; discount only against a clear value reduction, never to fit a misaligned budget.

title: Judge reply to proposal for objections
item: A prospect's reply to a proposal email
questions: choice:response - accepts, questions_scope, price_objection, wants_discount, stalling, declines; noul:anti_icp_signal
action: Code updates the CRM stage and routes price objections to the owner with the value-conversation notes
why_jev: Fast triage of proposal replies keeps the owner focused; stages and decline reasons come out of one cheap label.
doctrine: Do not discount reflexively when price reaction is negative; hold the floor or decline politely.

title: Check client onboarding replies against the access checklist
item: A client's reply to the password and access checklist
questions: choice:item_status - provided_admin, provided_view_only, pending, refused, unclear; choice:item - from the checklist items
action: Code updates the onboarding checklist and flags view-only access where admin is required (GSC disavow, Ads)
why_jev: Client replies are messy free text; a catalog of checklist items plus a status label updates onboarding state without manual transcription.
doctrine: View-only access blocks most steps; confirm admin access explicitly before work that needs it.

title: Check a client's described review workflow for a named owner and moment
item: A client's description of how reviews are requested
questions: noul:names_an_owner; noul:tied_to_a_real_operational_moment; noul:neutral_non_selective
action: Code marks the workflow installed only if all three are true, and otherwise schedules coaching
why_jev: 'Client will ask for reviews' is not a workflow; three yes/no checks on the description verify it is.
doctrine: Put the ask into one real operational moment with one named owner, not 'client will ask'.

title: Detect shared-device or incentive tactics in review practices
item: A client's described front-desk review practice
questions: noul:uses_shared_device_or_staff_account; noul:offers_incentive_or_priority
action: Code raises a compliance task and pauses the workflow rollout
why_jev: Practices drift from the script; a read of client-submitted descriptions finds drift early.
doctrine: Reviews should come from the reviewer's own device and account, with no incentives.

title: Spot injectables brand-name spam in anchor profiles
item: An anchor or linking page for an aesthetic client
questions: noul:brand_name_anchor_from_low_quality_source; noul:automated_directory_pattern
action: Code lists these first in anchor risk review for aesthetic non-surgical clients
why_jev: Aesthetic non-surgical clients have heavier brand-name link spam exposure; the cheap pre-sort puts the riskiest links first.
doctrine: Aesthetic non-surgical profiles carry brand-name link spam; anchor patterns are often the highest-risk links.

title: Flag platform-policy risk in aesthetic social and ad creative
item: A social or ad creative description (caption, image description, headline)
questions: noul:body_altering_or_before_after_content; noul:implies_personal_attribute_targeting; choice:platform_risk - low, medium, high
action: Code holds high-risk creative for compliance and tags medium for review
why_jev: Meta and TikTok policies vary; a quick pre-screen of creative text prevents account flags before spend.
doctrine: Aesthetic non-surgical platforms have policy risk; do not promise scaling without naming it.

title: Judge legal prospect readiness from trigger context
item: A legal prospect's inquiry text
questions: choice:context - pre_incident_planning, post_trigger_urgent, general_education; score:urgency
action: Code routes urgent post-trigger inquiries to same-day response and sends education intents to nurture content
why_jev: Section 1 readiness varies sharply in estate planning; a two-way label with urgency drives the right response speed.
doctrine: Pre-incident planning and post-trigger urgency are very different prospect mindsets.

title: Check legal testimonial-style content against state restrictions
item: A client page or post that includes testimonials, reviews, or results
questions: noul:testimonial_or_result_claim; noul:disclaimer_present
action: Code routes testimonial content to attorney contact review and blocks publish without disclaimers
why_jev: Legal advertising limits on testimonials are state-specific; a detector for such content ensures nothing ships without the review.
doctrine: Bar rules constrain testimonial and advocacy content more than medical.

title: Decide whether a zero-referring-domain page needs a press release
item: A page summary and its primary keyword with referring domain count from code
questions: noul:news_angle_present; choice:press_angle - new_service, award, community_event, research_or_data, none
action: Code creates a press release task only when referring domains equal zero and an angle exists
why_jev: Count is code; whether there is a credible newsworthy angle is semantic and prevents press releases on empty pages.
doctrine: A page with zero referring domains gets at least one backlink, for example via a press release.

title: Check competitor image richness gap
item: A page's image descriptions and a competitor set's image descriptions
questions: choice:gap_type - none, more_original_photos, more_procedure_diagrams, more_team_images, more_alt_text_coverage
action: Code routes to Service Page Image Optimization with the gap type
why_jev: Image gaps are semantic and feed a different SOP; a gap type lets code route without manual review.
doctrine: Where competitors have richer image content, route to image optimization.

title: Check that Brand Sprint style niche blog posts stay on a niche
item: A proposed post title and the client's niche list
questions: choice:niche - one entry per niche, plus off_niche; noul:links_naturally_to_home_page_topic
action: Code accepts on-niche posts and sends off-niche to the strategist
why_jev: Niche fit is a catalog lookup for each batch of three posts per client.
doctrine: Niche posts support the optimised target page, which must be live first.

title: Judge whether a heading or block needs a reviewer attribution
item: A page section with clinical or legal advice
questions: noul:contains_clinical_claims; noul:educational_only
action: Code skips the Medically Reviewed By block only for educational pages without clinical claims or for legal pages
why_jev: The block-skip rule rests on 'clinical claims present'; a yes/no per page prevents both over- and under-attribution.
doctrine: Medically Reviewed By skips for legal and pure education without clinical claims.

title: Spot invented statistics or studies in drafts
item: A sentence containing a number or study reference
questions: noul:specific_statistic_or_study_cited; noul:source_given_in_text
action: Code sends sentences with a statistic but no source to a fact-check queue
why_jev: Fabricated stats are a drafting failure; cheap detection of stat sentences focuses the fact-check on the right lines.
doctrine: The gate catches invented stats and absolute claims as a compliance floor.

title: Classify analytics annotations for event windows
item: A change annotation or note from the team log
questions: choice:type - site_change, content_change, ad_change, tracking_change, external_event, algorithm_update, other
action: Code uses types to align changes against signal windows in SPC and to reset measurement bases after tracking changes
why_jev: Resetting the measurement basis after tracking fixes depends on knowing which events were tracking changes; labelling free-text notes makes that automatic.
doctrine: A tracking fix resets the measurement basis; post-fix counts are not comparable to pre-fix.

title: Interpret rank-drop analyst notes into diagnostic families
item: An analyst's short note on a ranking drop
questions: choice:family - algo_update_timing, lost_backlinks, competitor_improvement, thin_content_or_cannibalisation, technical_regression, unknown
action: Code orders the diagnostic checklist by family and attaches the matching tool exports
why_jev: The diagnostic signals list names five families; a quick label orders the investigation before the 4-6 hour cycle starts.
doctrine: Scan diagnostic signals before the full cycle: algo timing, lost backlinks, competitor gains, volatility.

title: Check keyword-group membership for rank tracking
item: A keyword and the client's service and location lists
questions: choice:group - service_term, location_modified, branded, informational, competitor, irrelevant
action: Code adds keywords to the right rank-tracker group and drops irrelevant ones
why_jev: Rank tracker setup needs grouped keywords; a bulk label saves manual list work.
doctrine: Money-page identification uses the rank-tracker keyword group.

title: Judge whether a client page is worth a deep tuning pass
item: A page's keyword, current position band, and brief summary
questions: choice:action - quick_recheck, full_tuning, route_to_gap_analysis, leave_alone
action: Code assigns the right depth and budget
why_jev: Not every page deserves a Cora full run; a depth label keeps spend where it earns.
doctrine: Use quick mode only for low-competition re-checks and full mode for competitive pages.

title: Decide flat versus down outcome causes at the 4-6 week check
item: The pre and post GSC deltas plus recent changes
questions: choice:next_step - done_moving_up, check_edits_still_live, route_to_gap_analysis, check_technical_regression, check_over_optimisation
action: Code opens the matching follow-up task
why_jev: The doctrine gives a decision tree after the outcome check; Jev routes based on a text summary of deltas and edits.
doctrine: Flat means confirm edits live then route to gap analysis; down means check technical regression first.

title: Check that GBP services match page titles and keyword strategy
item: A GBP service name and the site page title catalog
questions: choice:matching_page - one entry per service page, plus no_match
action: Code lists mismatched services for correction
why_jev: Alignment between GBP services and pages is a catalog lookup that runs once per client and at each retune.
doctrine: Add the client's core services to GBP with names that match page titles and keyword strategy.

title: Detect spam or misleading Q&A on a profile
item: A user-submitted GBP question or answer
questions: choice:type - genuine_question, spam_or_promo, misleading, competitor_sabotage; noul:needs_answer
action: Code reports spam and misleading items via the platform report function and queues genuine questions for a response
why_jev: Q&A is public and noisy; a continuous check prevents spam sitting on the profile.
doctrine: Remove spammy or misleading Q&As via report; answer genuine ones promptly.

title: Triage legal directory descriptions for state advertising constraints
item: A long description for a legal client's directory listing
questions: noul:comparative_or_superlative_claim; noul:outcome_implied
action: Code blocks submission without firm compliance sign-off
why_jev: Directory descriptions replicate across many sites; screening before submission avoids long cleanup.
doctrine: Firm compliance review of descriptions is mandatory for every legal engagement before submission.

title: Verify practitioner NAP against registry record text
item: GBP name and address text and NPI or bar record text
questions: choice:match - exact, formatting_difference, material_mismatch, cannot_tell
action: Code stops the NAP lock on material_mismatch and asks the client to resolve first
why_jev: NPI records and GBP names use different formats; code handles exact, Jev handles fuzzy cases that are still the same entity.
doctrine: If GBP and NPI disagree, stop and resolve with the client; NPI is the canonical practitioner record.

title: Detect hard-coded competitor names in ad copy
item: An ad headline or description
questions: noul:names_a_competitor_brand_in_copy
action: Code rejects and substitutes keyword insertion where allowed, or sends to the owner
why_jev: Hard-coding a competitor's brand is a legal risk; a quick check on every draft prevents it.
doctrine: Do not hard-code a competitor's brand name in copy; use keyword insertion with legal review.

title: Detect common-sense negatives from search terms
item: A search term
questions: noul:clearly_irrelevant_for_a_local_medical_practice - free, DIY, jobs, training, or unrelated services; choice:negative_type - exact, phrase
action: Code adds singular and plural forms to a 'never want' list after a human skim of the batch
why_jev: Common-sense negatives are a judgment on thousands of terms; an AI pre-filter leaves humans only a skim.
doctrine: Add common-sense negatives, singular and plural, to a dedicated never-want list.

title: Detect cross-region intent in near-me terms
item: A near-me or location search term
questions: choice:location_relation - inside_service_area, adjacent_area_reachable, out_of_area
action: Code adds out_of_area terms as exact negatives, since presence targeting cannot block them by geography
why_jev: Presence targeting cannot block out-of-area queries by location; the term text must be judged against the service area.
doctrine: Under Presence targeting, a local user searching an out-of-area place name needs a keyword negative.

title: Judge whether ad schedule exclusions remove a served population
item: A proposed hour or day exclusion with conversion data summary text
questions: noul:population_removed_is_currently_served; noul:data_window_sufficient
action: Code approves hard exclusions only if the removed population is real and the 90-day window supports it
why_jev: Hour and day slicing in thin data is noise; a check stops over-fitting before a write.
doctrine: Use 90 days, not 30, for day and hour slicing; act via hard exclusion only.

title: Classify policy limited ads by evidence type
item: A policy topic entry text
questions: choice:fix_owner - ad_copy, landing_page_content, account_certification, compliance_team
action: Code routes the entry to the correct owner and reports near-universal limits once at account level
why_jev: Policy entries are verbose; a closed owner label sends each to the right fix track.
doctrine: Report policy findings once at the right altitude with the correct owner.

title: Screen copy for exploiting dissatisfaction or self-rejection
item: A headline, ad, or paragraph for an aesthetic or medical client
questions: noul:manufactures_insecurity_or_self_rejection - implies the reader is flawed or having a bad day and should fix it; noul:pressure_on_vulnerable_state
action: Code blocks the copy and returns it to the copywriter with the flagged sentence
why_jev: The doctrine's ethical floor is semantic and subtle (not a keyword); a cheap always-on check on every draft makes it part of the pipeline, with humans deciding borderline cases.
doctrine: Never market to manufactured unsatisfaction or self-rejection; the ethical floor applies especially to procedure verticals.

title: Classify lead outcomes including still-searching
item: An intake note describing what happened to a lead
questions: choice:outcome - converted_to_consult, converted_to_procedure, lost_to_competitor, still_in_market, no_show, unqualified, unknown
action: Code counts still_in_market leads to feed back into the next Searching attempt and adds consult versus procedure counts to the funnel report
why_jev: The model names a third state (not converted, still searching) most funnels ignore; typing intake notes makes the state measurable across the EMR boundary.
doctrine: A lead that did not convert but keeps searching is still in the market, not simply lost.

title: Tier conversion events as micro or macro
item: A GA4 event name with its trigger description
questions: choice:tier - macro_form_or_booked_call, macro_qualified_call, micro_cta_or_scroll, micro_phone_click, not_a_conversion
action: Code assigns two-tier values and imports only macro and micro events to Ads, never changing the goal after launch
why_jev: The setup needs a micro and macro tier at about $0.10 versus real value; labelling event names speeds up the setup across every client account.
doctrine: Set two-tier conversion values: micro for stepping stones, macro for money actions; do not change the goal after launch.

title: Judge whether a form asks for unnecessary information
item: A form field label and the page's primary conversion goal
questions: choice:necessity - required_for_booking, useful_not_required, unnecessary_friction, sensitive_phi_risk
action: Code recommends removing or deferring unnecessary_friction fields and flags PHI-risk fields
why_jev: Ash's 'too much info asked' sin is a necessity judgment on each field; a typed label also catches PHI risk early.
doctrine: Landing page sin: asking too much information; minimise fields and watch PHI.

title: Check thank-you page works as second landing page
item: Thank-you page text
questions: noul:explains_next_step; noul:offers_clear_call_now_action; noul:benefit_of_next_conversation_stated
action: Code flags thin thank-you pages and queues a rewrite
why_jev: Thank-you pages are usually ignored; three yes/no checks reveal the ones that waste the post-lead moment.
doctrine: Treat the thank-you page as a second landing page that explains the next conversation and offers a call-now action.

title: Classify FAQ items by objection type
item: One FAQ question and answer on a landing page
questions: choice:objection - cost, safety_or_risk, recovery_or_downtime, credentials, logistics_or_location, results, other; noul:real_objection_not_filler
action: Code reports missing objection types per page and flags filler
why_jev: A strong finish needs FAQs that answer real objections; typed labels reveal which are missing.
doctrine: A FAQ should address real objections, then a final pitch repeats the CTA.

title: Dedupe findings confirmed by two crawl tools
item: Two issue descriptions from Screaming Frog and Labrika or GSC for the same URL
questions: noul:same_issue; choice:relation - identical, related, different
action: Code merges identical issues, marks them dual-confirmed, and elevates priority
why_jev: Dual-confirmed issues get higher priority, but each tool words the same finding differently; a pairwise identity call is a pure dedupe job.
doctrine: Issues confirmed by both tools are elevated in priority; single-source findings get lower weight.

title: Judge whether schema values appear on the visible page
item: A schema property value and the visible page text
questions: noul:value_visible_on_page; noul:contradicts_page_text
action: Code raises a QA failure for non-visible or contradicting schema values
why_jev: Schema must describe visible facts; checking a claim against page text across hundreds of pages is a cheap consistency job.
doctrine: Structured data must describe visible page facts, not manufacture location signals.

title: Test area pages against the doorway-page guardrail
item: An area page's body text
questions: score:unique_usefulness - city-name swap (1) to distinct route, access, and audience value (5); noul:mostly_templated
action: Code blocks publishing for area pages scoring 2 or less and shows the repeated template text
why_jev: A city-name swap is the failure the guardrail targets; a usefulness score on each generated page is far cheaper than reading each.
doctrine: Area pages need enough unique usefulness to clear the doorway-page guardrail.

title: Compare area pages pairwise for template duplication
item: Two area pages' body text
questions: choice:similarity - distinct, partially_templated, nearly_identical
action: Code lists nearly_identical pairs for rewrite or consolidation
why_jev: Pairwise similarity across dozens of area pages is a classic dedupe use for a cheap model.
doctrine: Do not force every area page into a city-and-directions template.

title: Classify entity types in an entity master list
item: A Cora or On-Page.ai entity term
questions: choice:entity_type - procedure, condition, anatomy, device_or_brand, credential, location, person, other
action: Code organises the entity master list and the topical authority map by type
why_jev: Entity lists run hundreds of rows; typing them is bulk sorting that makes cluster planning and anchor sourcing possible.
doctrine: Entity vocabulary informs anchor text and topical authority planning.

title: Map AI-visibility prompts to client services
item: A prompt in the AI visibility tracking set and the service catalog
questions: choice:service - one entry per client service, plus none; choice:intent - local_provider_search, procedure_research, comparison, cost, safety
action: Code groups prompt performance by service and intent for reporting
why_jev: AI visibility prompts need service and intent tags to be reportable; a catalog lookup per prompt is cheap.
doctrine: AI is a cross-cutting force; measure visibility across services and intents.

title: Type meeting notes into decisions, actions, and risks
item: One line from client meeting notes
questions: choice:kind - decision, action_agency, action_client, risk, information, open_question
action: Code appends decisions to the decision log, creates tasks, and flags open questions for the next prep brief
why_jev: The decision log feeds future briefs; typing every note line builds it automatically.
doctrine: Lead with the decision the client must make; respect prior decisions in future calls.

title: Score draft against brand voice description
item: A paragraph of a draft and the client's brand voice summary
questions: score:voice_fit - off-brand (1) to unmistakably on-brand (5); noul:generic_ai_tone
action: Code flags paragraphs under 3 for rewrite before client approval
why_jev: Voice fit gets checked at the end by a human; a cheap per-paragraph score highlights the lines that will draw edits and reduces approval loops.
doctrine: Posts draw on the brand voice on file before client approval.

title: Check review text reuse against release records
item: A marketing page or post that quotes a review and the release register
questions: noul:review_text_present; choice:release_status - written_consent_on_file, no_consent, platform_terms_issue, unknown
action: Code blocks publication of reused reviews without consent on file
why_jev: Reuse of platform reviews needs consent and clearance; matching quoted text to a register is a catalog lookup.
doctrine: Platform review text is not automatically reusable marketing copy; consent and compliance review are required.

title: Dedupe near-identical RSA headlines
item: Two RSA headlines from one ad
questions: choice:relation - distinct, near_duplicate, identical_meaning
action: Code removes near-duplicates and asks for new angles to keep headline diversity
why_jev: Ad strength and testing require distinct angles; pairwise duplicate checks across 15 headlines are cheap at write time.
doctrine: Rotate evenly and test distinct angles; duplicate headlines waste test capacity.

title: Check ad copy for clear competitor-hours or offer claims
item: An ad description
questions: noul:implies_availability_not_offered; noul:unsubstantiated_offer
action: Code blocks copy that implies hours or offers the client does not provide
why_jev: Ad claims about hours or offers must match reality; a text check helps catch mismatches before the ad runs.
doctrine: Do not hard-code claims the client cannot support; compare ad promises to real offers.

title: Flag links likely built by the client or a prior agency
item: A link with context and notes about prior agency work
questions: noul:likely_built_by_client_or_prior_agency; noul:paid_link_pattern
action: Code excludes such links from the disavow list and asks the PM about prior agency context
why_jev: Disavowing links the client or agency built, such as a PBN, can hurt; the doctrine says check history first.
doctrine: Do not disavow links built by the client or past agency without checking context.

title: Classify citation audit duplicates by type
item: A duplicate listing found in a citation audit
questions: choice:duplicate_type - exact_duplicate, old_address, practitioner_variant, merged_chain_entry, different_business
action: Code routes exact and old-address duplicates to cleanup and others to senior-seo
why_jev: Duplicate suppression is destructive; typing each duplicate gives the right path and prevents wrong merges.
doctrine: Duplicate suppression is destructive; flag to senior-seo before any action.

title: Label client-level data for HIPAA-safe tool routing
item: A file or text chunk to be analysed in an AI tool
questions: choice:sensitivity - public_page_content, internal_strategy, contains_phi_or_quasi_identifiers, legal_privileged
action: Code sends public content to the standard model, PHI to a BAA-covered surface or manual path, and privileged content to no model
why_jev: Routing by sensitivity is the central risk control in medical and legal accounts; a fast classifier at the front door is cheaper and safer than discipline alone.
doctrine: Claude.ai is not BAA-covered; use a BAA-covered surface or manual synthesis for medical client analysis.

title: Check primary conversion prominence in wireframe text
item: A wireframe description listing page elements in order
questions: choice:most_prominent_action - primary_conversion, secondary_conversion, navigation, content; noul:primary_above_fold
action: Code fails wireframes where the most prominent action is not the primary conversion
why_jev: The PM must confirm the primary is the most prominent action; text descriptions can be pre-checked quickly.
doctrine: Name the single primary conversion and make it the most prominent action on the wireframe.

title: Judge whether a GA4 event definition could capture PHI
item: A GA4 event and parameter list
questions: noul:parameters_include_health_detail; noul:url_includes_procedure_and_demographics
action: Code blocks the event and applies the micro-conversion directional approach
why_jev: PHI-capturing tracking is a quiet risk that appears in parameter names; a cheap check on all events guards every analytics setup.
doctrine: Where full tracking is impossible for HIPAA reasons, use micro-conversions as directional signals.

title: Check redirect chains and loops on primary URLs for plausibility
item: A redirect chain description with URLs
questions: noul:final_target_matches_intent; noul:loop_or_circular_logic
action: Code collapses chains to the final intent-matched target in the redirect map
why_jev: Code finds chains; whether the final destination matches the original intent needs a semantic look.
doctrine: Collapse redirect chains to a single direct 301 to the topically relevant page.

title: Judge whether a competitor change explains a gradual decline
item: A competitor's recent page change summary and our page summary
questions: choice:change_type - added_content_depth, improved_structure, added_entities_or_schema, gained_links, no_notable_change
action: Code attaches the change type to the gap analysis and routes to the matching SOP
why_jev: A gradual decline is usually a competitor improving; typing observed changes shortens the diagnosis.
doctrine: Gradual decline over 2+ months usually means competitors improved; focus on what they changed.

title: Classify BWT and GSC crawl errors into response types
item: A crawl error entry
questions: choice:response - move_301, gone_410, server_fix, collapse_redirect_chain, dns_issue, ignore_low_value
action: Code builds the redirect map and task list by response type
why_jev: Resolution by error type is rule-based once the type is known; the error text is varied and a classifier normalises it.
doctrine: Resolution by type: moved gets 301, gone gets 410, 500 goes to server, chains collapse to one 301.

title: Detect single-tactic requests that need system reframing
item: A prospect's stated request
questions: noul:single_tactic_only; choice:tactic - website_only, social_only, ads_only, seo_only, none
action: Code attaches the reframing guidance and flags the inquiry for decline unless the system engagement is accepted
why_jev: The playbook treats single-tactic fixation as an Anti-ICP signal; catching it at intake saves a call.
doctrine: Both halves of expertise must be bought; a vendor-only tactic request is usually Anti-ICP.
